title: Radiofrequency Ablation in Patients With Barrett's Esophagus
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to establish a nationwide registry to collect data regarding the treatment of Barrett's Esophagus (BE) with radiofrequency ablation. The objective of this registry is to increase the number of data and therefore obtain a raise of quality assurance and improve outcome and patient security. Furthermore to provide participating physicians information and experience for treatment details in the therapy of BE.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a histological confirmed BE, who give their informed consent for participation in an anonymized registry.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients, who do not give informed consent.
study_population: Each center should define a system for identification and eligibility screening of patients.
